newsitem.title: USA: Noble resumes West Delta production.
newsitem.headline: Noble resumes West Delta production.

text.p: Noble Affiliates Inc said oil and natural gas production has commenced from its West Delta 57/58 and 60 properties off Louisiana in the Gulf of Mexico.
The properties, in which Noble owns a 95 and 25 percent working interest, respectively, have been shut-in since April 1996 due to mechanical problems downstream at a third party processing facility.
Noble officials did not return calls Thursday or Friday seeking the names of other owners of the properties and the processing facility.

It said West Delta 57/58 is producing about 1,160 barrels of oil and 12 million cubic feet of natural gas per day, net to the company's interest. West Delta 60 is producing 400 barrels of oil and one million cubic feet of gas per day, net to Noble's interest.
